name: WLAN Monitor
author: uBruckhaus
description: See who is on your Wi-Fi from the bar: every device with a type icon and plain-language status, your own names, new-device alerts, groups by platform, type or Wi-Fi band, a network map, live Network Monitor (active connections, per-app traffic, interfaces, filters), built-in Network & Wi-Fi Setup (safe NetworkManager integration), FRITZ!Box mesh details, VPN detection, and a local MCP server. Automatic subnet sweeps only on networks you trust (or when you click Rescan).

barWidget.description: Devices on your Wi-Fi, router access, signal and traffic
